title: Stabilized Power Supply from a PC Power Supply

information.value: Stabilized outputs (+3.3V / +5V / +12V / -12V) / Main switch / Distribution switch to terminals / LED indicator showing current delivery / Secured connection terminals

description: This personal project aimed to transform a PC power supply into a stabilized power supply, providing the standard voltages used in electronics (+3.3V, +5V, +12V, and -12V).
The goal was to have a reliable and safe power supply to power various electronic circuits at home, particularly for prototyping and DIY electronics projects.

The project started in 2023 and was completed at the beginning of the 2024 school year. I carried out the entire project on my own, from retrieving the PC power supply to designing the enclosure, including integrating the necessary protections and controls.

The power supply features two switches: a main switch for the primary power and a secondary switch to enable or disable the power delivery to the connection terminals. A single LED indicates when current is being delivered to the terminals, ensuring safe usage.
This project allowed me to refine my skills in power electronics, secure wiring, and designing power systems tailored to the needs of personal electronic projects.
